changes: Edit your own sent messages: press Up in an empty message box, or E on a highlighted message
Play GIFs and videos in the chat, and open them full size
Copy, save or open a photo or video with c, s and x on the highlighted message
Name your accounts, such as "Personal WhatsApp" and "Work WhatsApp", with Rename account in the palette
Block a contact, and report spam on Telegram, from the palette
Mark a chat as read or unread from the palette
A chat you have open no longer shows new messages as unread
Safer handling of images, videos, links and files you receive
See a photo, video or file's size and dimensions before you open it
Spell check: misspelled words are underlined as you type, with suggestions
See how many unread messages each service has, right from the bar
Videos open reliably even if you click them more than once
Telegram messages with links and formatting display correctly again
Telegram sign-in: see the two-step verification password hint when needed
Signing in to Telegram by QR code no longer gets stuck if the code refreshes
Reply quotes show the right sender's name instead of a generic placeholder
Fixed Ctrl+J not inserting a new line while writing a message
Links and images hidden in a message's text can no longer load on their own
WhatsApp: key exchange messages no longer show up as a strange blank message
Notifications keep your messages private from other programs on your computer
The first release: Telegram and WhatsApp accounts, signed in by QR code or phone
Send and receive photos, videos, voice notes and files, with replies and reactions
Search everything with Ctrl+K, including message text across every chat
Fully keyboard-driven, with a command palette (Ctrl+/) listing every shortcut
Desktop notifications, with pin, archive, snooze and an unread-only view
